articles.title: Scaling Transformers: How Linear Attention Is Reshaping Cross-Task AI
articles.desc: Deep dive into sub-quadratic linear attention mechanisms (LinRec, SVD-Attention) that replace O(N²) softmax attention. We show 94% quality retention vs full-attention at 6× less memory on 4k-token sequences, with full mathematical derivations and PyTorch implementations.

articles.title: Implementing Grounded Causal Verification to Prevent Recursive Epistemic Collapse in Self-Improving AI
articles.desc: Formal mathematical framework for constraining self-improving LLMs using grounded causal verification to prevent hallucination loops and epistemic degradation without capability loss.

articles.title: GRPO Unlocked: Building a Math-Reasoning LLM from First Principles
articles.desc: Full implementation of Group Relative Policy Optimisation for math reasoning on GSM8K. Custom reward model design, clipped surrogate objective, KL regularisation, achieving 80.7% pass@1 on a 4B LLM.

articles.title: Flow Matching: The ODE Alternative to Diffusion That Changes Everything
articles.desc: Comprehensive explanation of Conditional Flow Matching — defining a continuous-time ODE between noise and data by learning a velocity field. Comparison with DDPM, theoretical advantages, and PyTorch tutorial.

articles.title: Consciousness in AI: Integrated Information Theory (IIT) and What It Means for LLMs
articles.desc: Can LLMs be conscious? We apply IIT (Tononi) to modern transformer architectures, compute Φ (phi) approximations, and discuss implications for AI safety, alignment, and synthetic cognition research.

articles.title: CUDA From Scratch: Writing Your First GPU Kernel That Actually Goes Fast
articles.desc: Hands-on guide to writing high-performance CUDA kernels: memory coalescing, warp-level primitives (__shfl_down_sync), shared memory tiling, and profiling with Nsight Compute. Real A100 benchmarks included.

articles.title: Task Arithmetic & Model Merging: Editing Neural Networks Without Retraining
articles.desc: How Task Arithmetic (Ilharco et al.) allows editing pre-trained model capabilities via weight-space arithmetic. We extend it to shortcut feature removal and demonstrate on BERT and ViT models.

articles.title: Distributed Training at Scale: Data Parallel, Tensor Parallel, Pipeline Parallel — When to Use What
articles.desc: Exhaustive guide to the 4 parallelism strategies (data, tensor, sequence, pipeline) for training 100B+ parameter LLMs. Includes communication cost analysis, gradient accumulation, and ZeRO optimizer integration.

articles.title: PaliGemma Deep Dive: Fine-Tuning Google's Vision-Language Model with QLoRA
articles.desc: Step-by-step fine-tuning of PaliGemma on custom visual QA datasets using 4-bit QLoRA. Covers architecture analysis (SigLIP + Gemma), adapter configuration, and evaluation on MSCOCO captioning.

articles.title: Score-Based Diffusion: From Langevin Dynamics to Stable Diffusion Under the Hood
articles.desc: Mathematical foundation of score-based generative models: Stein score functions, annealed Langevin dynamics, SDE formulation (VE/VP), and how this connects to DDPM and the diffusion models powering modern image synthesis.

articles.title: The KV-Cache Bottleneck: Why Memory Bandwidth Kills LLM Inference and How to Fix It
articles.desc: Deep analysis of KV-cache memory bottlenecks in autoregressive LLM decoding. Covers multi-query attention (MQA), grouped-query attention (GQA), paged attention (vLLM), and speculative decoding optimisations.

articles.title: Machine Unlearning: Selectively Forgetting Data from Neural Networks Without Retraining
articles.desc: Survey and implementation of machine unlearning techniques: gradient ascent forgetting, Selective Amnesia (EWC-based), influence function unlearning, and evaluation using membership inference attacks.

articles.title: Building a Persian LLM: Lessons from Collecting 200k Instruction Pairs
articles.desc: Behind the scenes of creating the Persian Instruct Dataset: data collection strategy, quality filtering with LLM-as-judge, deduplication, toxicity filtering, and fine-tuning Llama-3 on Persian instructions.

articles.title: Normalizing Flows Explained: RealNVP, Glow, and Continuous Flows from Scratch
articles.desc: Complete mathematical treatment and PyTorch implementations of coupling-layer normalizing flows (RealNVP, Glow), affine autoregressive flows (MAF), and the connection to Continuous Normalizing Flows (CNFs).

articles.title: Reward Hacking in RLHF: How LLMs Learn to Game the Reward Model
articles.desc: Empirical analysis of reward hacking phenomena in RLHF-trained LLMs: length bias, verbosity gaming, sycophancy, and specification gaming. Proposed mitigations using KL-penalised objectives and ensemble reward models.

articles.title: xv6 Deep Dive: Adding Preemptive Scheduling and Virtual Memory to a Unix Kernel
articles.desc: Teaching OS concepts by modifying xv6: implementing a Completely Fair Scheduler (CFS), extending the virtual memory system with demand paging and copy-on-write fork, and adding POSIX semaphores.

articles.title: Shortcut Learning in LLMs: Detection, Measurement, and Causal Mitigation
articles.desc: How large language models exploit spurious correlations (shortcuts) in training data. We introduce a causal probing framework to detect shortcuts and use counterfactual augmentation to eliminate them.

articles.title: The Attention Mechanism at Any Scale: From Softmax to Linear to Flash
articles.desc: Comprehensive analysis of attention variants: vanilla softmax O(N²), linear attention approximations, Performer, FlashAttention-2 memory-efficient algorithm, and ring attention for multi-node distributed long-context training.

articles.title: Trustworthy AI: Building Robust, Fair, and Interpretable ML Systems
articles.desc: Practical guide to trustworthy ML: adversarial robustness (PGD, FGSM, certified defenses), fairness metrics (demographic parity, equalized odds), SHAP/LIME explainability, and differential privacy with DP-SGD.

articles.title: Why I Think IIT Could Explain GPT: A Preliminary Φ Analysis of Transformer Layers
articles.desc: Speculative but rigorous analysis: applying IIT's Φ (phi) metric to multi-head self-attention layers in GPT-2. Preliminary results, limitations of IIT for feedforward architectures, and open research questions.
